00051 #define DEFAULT_UGEN_DOCS   <I>Not yet documented although the argument name should be reasonably clear</I>.
00052 #define COMMON_UGEN_DOCS    <B>Generic %UGen argument documentation:</B>                                        \
00053                             Arguments which are UGen type can be continuously controlled and these              \
00054                             may generally be multichannel (although there are some exceptions).                 \
00055                             Arguments which are constant/literal values (e.g., float or int) are clearly        \
00056                             not continuously controllable and not multichannel (therefore will                  \
00057                             generallly be applied identically to each channel should the UGen being             \
00058                             created is made multichannel via other arguments.                                   \
00059                             Arguments which are Buffer type may require a Buffer for some specific              \
00060                             purpose (e.g, TableOsc uses a buffer for its wavetable) but single channel          \
00061                             Buffer objects are also used to specify an array of literal values (e.g., LLine)    \
00062                             \n\
00063                             \n\

00692     inline float* processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel = -1) throw()
00693     {   
00694         if(channel < 0) {
00695             // process all channels
00696             for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00697                 internalUGens[i]->processBlockInternal(shouldDelete, blockID, i);
00698             
00699             return 0;
00700         } else {
00701             // process one channel and return a pointer to its block
00702             int internalChannel = channel % numInternalUGens;
00703             float* block = internalUGens[internalChannel]->processBlockInternal(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00704             return block;
00705         }
00706     }

00718     float* prepareAndProcessBlock(const int actualBlockSize, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel = -1) throw();
00719     
00727     inline void prepareForBlock(const int actualBlockSize, const unsigned int blockID) throw()
00728     {   
00729         bool shouldDelete = false;
00730         
00731         for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++) {
00732             if(internalUGens[i]->shouldBeDeletedNow(blockID)) {
00733                 shouldDelete = true;
00734                 break;
00735             }
00736         }
00737         
00738         if(shouldDelete) {
00739             for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00740                 internalUGens[i]->decrementRefCount();
00741             
00742             numInternalUGens = 1;
00743             internalUGens[0] = getNullInternal();
00744             internalUGens[0]->prepareForBlockInternal(actualBlockSize, blockID);        
00745         } else {
00746             for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00747                 internalUGens[i]->prepareForBlockInternal(actualBlockSize, blockID);
00748         }
00749     }

01049     inline static void initialise() throw()
01050     {
01051         if(isInitialised == false)
01052         {
01053             null = UGen();
01054             nullKr = UGen().kr();
01055             Buffer::tableSine512  = Buffer::line( 513, 0.0, 2.0 * pi).sin().shrinkSize();
01056             Buffer::tableSine8192 = Buffer::line(8193, 0.0, 2.0 * pi).sin().shrinkSize();
01057 //          Buffer::tableSine512  = Buffer::line( 1025, 0.0, 4.0 * pi).sin().shrinkSize(512);
01058 //          Buffer::tableSine8192 = Buffer::line(16385, 0.0, 4.0 * pi).sin().shrinkSize(8192);
01059 
01060             Buffer constantPanTemp;
01061             constantPanTemp = Buffer::line(512, -pi4, pi4) << Buffer::line(512, pi4, -pi4);
01062             Buffer::tableConstantPan512 = (constantPanTemp.cos() - constantPanTemp.sin()) * sqrt22;
01063             isInitialised = true;
01064         }
01065     }
